narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Every card has a decimal in it, so all four are below one.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Seven times zero point six means six tenths of seven.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>More than half of seven is more than three, so that one is above one.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>When both numbers are below one, the product is below one.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>When one number is far above one, look at how big the part is before you decide.

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip says all four are below one, because every card has a decimal. Seven times zero point six takes more than half of seven, which is more than one.
